exposure: Pre- and post-integration of azithromycin prophylaxis
Integration of standard-dose (500 mg) azithromycin prophylaxis
cohort: 1273 patients with class III obesity undergoing unscheduled cesarean delivery
finding: Integration of standard-dose azithromycin prophylaxis reduced the risk of post-cesarean wound complications and unscheduled postpartum visits in patients with class III obesity.
